name: dsfd_wfc_vmx_p

job.purpose: S81 sp_wfc priced kit (VM_LINK 1, POSTED 1, RD2 1, VMRQ 64, WOUTW 8, HEP): the VM / stage-core port tile = dsfd_wfc_vmx_w (WFC -> VM write / START transport) + dsfd_wfc_vmx_r (VM -> WFC prefetch / DONE, slow -> fast ratio FIFO at RDEPTH 4, staging buffer in two 1R1W macros) + dsfd_wfc_hep_t (issue-epoch table on one SRAM macro). One tile because the slot's die pins are all on its 328-um E face and the closed link bridge takes 151.2 um of it: 172.8 um is left for every VM / core / HEP pin. Two related clocks (ck 833.3 ps, ckv 4/3), each root <= 15k sinks. 0 cycles added: cycle-exact with the one-tile kit in the cluster lockstep bench.
job.structural_change: the one-tile priced vmx (63k+ flops on one root; routes rq64w8 hold-stalled, rd2s TT -145.87) rebuilt: 32.8k-flop staging buffer -> two 1R1W macros behind a registered look-ahead, slow -> fast ratio FIFO depth 8 -> 4, HEP 2 x 13.3k-flop banks -> one SRAM macro with a 3-edge pipeline; ~26.5k flops over two roots (ck ~11.9k, ckv ~14.6k); p2: pin plan re-made after p1 crashed at IO placement (PPL-0093: 1,738 pins at 2 M4 tracks = 97 % of the 172.8-um E face): E face keeps the two wide buses t_swd / f_srq (1,553 pins, 86 %), the 185 narrow VM / core / HEP / fault pins leave on S at the E end (the die pins below y 43 of the slot's E face), balanced pin placer with per-port ranges; p3: regional FIFO read pointers (32bit groups f2s /64bit s2f, each mux driver <=256loads), one-hot local read successor removes binary increment/wrap from pin read-enable path without added cycles; related-root physical balancing from actual sequential clock-pin mean instead of mixed macro extrema, legalized at every buffer stage. Independent pointer reset/stall/phase scoreboard80 exact+2mutants and productionparent6exact+7mutants.

floorplan_why: 781.92 x 172.8 (height = the E face left under the 151.2-um link bridge on the 43.2-um child lattice). 8 macros = 49.0k um2, std ~18.5k um2 (vmx_w 7.1k + vmx_r 10.5k + hep 0.85k), overall utilisation ~52 %. Flow E -> W for reads: 1,026 response pins (E) -> response-queue macros (3 columns x 2 rows at x 429.8 / 546.5 / 663.1, write data in from the E pins, rd_out on their W faces) -> queue output buffer + slow -> fast ratio FIFO in the 44-um band at x 387..432 and in the macro channels -> staging macros (x 22.5 and 216, rd_out W) -> vm_rq flops at the W pins. Writes W -> E: WFC pins (W) -> pre-queue / fast -> slow FIFO in the 73-um band above the staging macros -> write skid / link register -> E pins. HEP macro (generated 512 x 64, 96.6 x 29.7) in the sixth queue slot at the E pins. >= 20 um channels around every macro; E pin strip 24 um; no pins on N; the 782-um span is forced by the macro row under a 172.8-um face (two 171-um staging macros + three 95-um queue columns + channels), measured by the --cts gate. Cut W-E through the tile at the staging macros: 527 b write + 1,032 b read over 73 um of free M2 / M4 height (2 x 1,520 tracks) -> 0.51. Pins (p2): E = t_swd y 4..58, f_srq y 62..166; S at x 680..732 = f_kd t_ks t_hep t_srd t_ft and the handshake bits (185 pins: 43 um from the slot's E-face pins below the tile); W = the WFC buses; clocks / resets S centre. p3 keeps die-assigned requested physical port ranges and footprint; changes local RTL pointer placement/fanout and clock-root physical measurement, no timing exceptions added.
